skirmish.module.market.name: Auction
skirmish.module.market.description: Price per item on /ah lots, the cheapest lot and a price history. Hints only: it never buys or clicks.
skirmish.module.market.setting.overlay.t: In the auction window, show the price per item on every lot. Green is well below the usual price, red above it. «↑» marks a bid that may still rise.
skirmish.module.market.setting.highlight: Ring the cheapest lot per item of every item on the page (when there are at least two such lots).
skirmish.module.market.setting.tooltip.t: Add the price per item, the usual price from the history and a cheaper/dearer flag to the lot tooltip.
skirmish.module.market.setting.history.t: Remember prices you see and your purchases in config/skirmish/prices.json (this computer only). The usual price comes from it.
skirmish.module.market.setting.tolerance: How far the price per item must be from the usual one (14-day median) for the lot to be flagged.
skirmish.market.tooltip.bid: This is a bid: the price may still rise
skirmish.market.tooltip.cheapest: Cheapest per item on this page
